subject: phy-u-fund
title: (R)PHY.U.FUND.-----DYM.F.
description: Diagram opening MP(II)-16 — the section on the wane of American world-political influence and the move away from America in the political-thrust of world politics. The prose immediately below identifies the structural target: 'the political dynamics of capitalism is not universally viewed as a positive political philosophy. Moreover, it is important that the collective move away from America is viewed seriously... Any movement that hopes to really re-establish itself must necessarily view both America and the Soviet Union as a negative factor.' The crossing diagrams how the reality of physical-universe-fundamental structurally meets dynamic-functionalism at the post-American world-political scale: (R)PHY-U-FUND (the reality of physical universe fundamental) crossed with DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). PHY-U-FUND sits on the left with the subject-arrow; IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) rises from the main line at top-center, and LANG-DY (language dynamics) branches from the IF-ST-DY line. DYM-F is the partner at the end of the main line at upper-right. MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from the main line to the right margin, VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) drops from the MT-INFO line, and INTR (interpretation) branches from the VT-DY line. C-CONT (composite continuance) drops from the main line to the bottom-center, and IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) branches from the C-CONT line.
